les: Die naaldwoud: bome wat die lang winter uithou
kaps_punt: Ligging op Aarde | Klimaat: temperatuur - en reënvalpatrone (maandelikse gemiddeldes) | Natuurlike plantegroei en wildlewe in 'n naaldwoud

items.bewering: Die grootste naaldwoude lê in 'n breë band oor die verre noorde van die wêreld.
items.blok: Waar die naaldwoude lê
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Taiga': 'The taiga, or boreal forest, is the world's largest land biome', 'found throughout the high northern latitudes'. Britannica (subarctic climate, via search): a broad swath from about 50° to 70° N.

items.bewering: Die band loop deur Kanada, die noorde van Europa en die noorde van Rusland.
items.blok: Waar die naaldwoude lê
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Taiga' (most of inland Canada, Alaska; Norway, Sweden, Finland; Russia); Britannica subarctic climate (Alaska to Newfoundland; northern Scandinavia to Siberia). Alaska is left out, but the list does not claim to be complete.

items.bewering: In die verre suide van die wêreld is daar nie so 'n band nie. Op dieselfde afstand suid van die ewenaar lê daar byna net see.
items.blok: Waar die naaldwoude lê
items.bron: Ohio University, Dyer, 'The Physical Environment', subarctic climate page: the climate 'is only found in the Northern Hemisphere because there is no large landmass at the same latitude in the Southern Hemisphere'. Between 50° and 70° S the only land is the tip of South America, small islands and the edge of Antarctica, so 'byna net see' holds.

items.bewering: 'n Woud kan net op land groei.
items.blok: Waar die naaldwoude lê
items.bron: By definition: the FAO Forest Resources Assessment defines a forest as land with trees; Wikipedia 'Taiga' calls it a land biome.

items.bewering: Die naaldwoud het 'n lang winter wat baie koud is. Die somer is kort en sag.
items.blok: 'n Lang winter en 'n kort somer
items.bron: Skybrary, 'Subarctic Climate (Dfc)': coldest month below 0 °C, only 1-3 months above 10 °C; Wikipedia 'Subarctic climate': winter below −50 °C is possible; Ohio University subarctic page: the frost-free period is 'only three months long'.

items.bewering: Die maandelikse gemiddeldes wys 'n groot verskil tussen die koudste en die warmste maand. Dit is 'n groter verskil as in die reënwoud of in die warm woestyn.
items.blok: 'n Lang winter en 'n kort somer
items.bron: Britannica, subarctic climate (via search): annual temperature ranges 'larger ... than in any other climate type on Earth', up to 30 °C over much of the area and more than 60 °C in central Siberia. Ohio University subarctic page: 'the largest annual temperature range of any climate on Earth'. Royal Geographical Society world environments fact sheet: the rainforest's yearly range is a few degrees.

items.bewering: Daar val nie baie reën in 'n jaar nie, en in die winter val die water meestal as sneeu.
items.blok: 'n Lang winter en 'n kort somer
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Taiga': 'relatively low precipitation throughout the year (generally 200–750 mm)', 'also as snow'; Ohio University subarctic page: 380-500 mm a year.

items.bewering: Oor die grootste deel van die band val die meeste van die jaar se water in die somer, as reën.
items.blok: 'n Lang winter en 'n kort somer
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Taiga': precipitation falls 'primarily as rain during the summer months'; Ohio University subarctic page: 'concentrated during the warmer months', at Yakutsk summer precipitation is three times winter's. The qualifier 'oor die grootste deel' rightly leaves out the more maritime edges.

items.bewering: Die sneeu smelt nie dadelik nie en hoop maande lank op. Daarom lê die sneeu diep, al val daar min water.
items.blok: 'n Lang winter en 'n kort somer
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Taiga': snow can lie 'for as long as nine months' in the far north. Atlas of Canada, 'Average Maximum Snow Depth' (open.canada.ca): 'a band of higher snow accumulation follows the boreal forest zone'. The mechanism (it piles up because it does not melt) is right; depth varies across the band, but 'diep' is a fair word for it here.

items.bewering: Op die Januariekaart lê hierdie band diep in die koue streke. In die noorde van die wêreld val Januarie in die winter en Julie in die somer. Op die Juliekaart is dieselfde band veel minder koud.
items.blok: Wat die kaarte van hierdie band wys
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Subarctic climate' (northern winter below −50 °C, summer can top 26 °C) and Skybrary Dfc (coldest month below 0 °C, 1-3 months above 10 °C). Northern-hemisphere winter in January and summer in July is the standard basis for these climate tables.

items.bewering: Die reënvalkaart wys oor die grootste deel van die band minder reën as in die reënwoud.
items.blok: Wat die kaarte van hierdie band wys
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Taiga': 200-750 mm a year (1 000 mm in some areas), well below a tropical rainforest's annual total (Royal Geographical Society world environments fact sheet).

items.bewering: Twee kaarte is dus nodig om hierdie plek se hele jaar te wys.
items.blok: Wat die kaarte van hierdie band wys
items.bron: This follows from the large seasonal range confirmed above (Britannica / Ohio University subarctic climate): the January and July temperature maps show opposite extremes.

items.bewering: Die natuurlike plantegroei van 'n naaldwoud is meestal bome met blare soos smal naalde.
items.blok: Die natuurlike plantegroei: naalde en keëls
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Taiga' (coniferous forest, evergreen needles). Mapping checked: the comparison is to shape only and says plainly that the needles ARE leaves, so a learner who reasons on from it does not end up treating needles as something other than leaves. The comparison holds.

items.bewering: 'n Naald verloor minder water as 'n breë blaar.
items.blok: Die natuurlike plantegroei: naalde en keëls
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Taiga': 'The adaptation of evergreen needles limits the water lost due to transpiration.'

items.bewering: In plaas van blomme dra hierdie naaldbome keëls met saad daarin.
items.blok: Die natuurlike plantegroei: naalde en keëls
items.bron: Britannica Kids, 'Conifer': 'woody cones with seeds attached to the scales'; Careers360 / Gardener's Path: gymnosperms have no flowers, and cones take their place.

items.bewering: Die meeste naaldbome hou hulle naalde die hele jaar deur.
items.blok: Die natuurlike plantegroei: naalde en keëls
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Taiga' (evergreen needles; larch is the deciduous exception) and 'Larch' (a deciduous conifer).

items.bewering: In hierdie naaldwoud laat een soort naaldboom sy naalde in die herfs val. Woude van hierdie boom dek 'n enorme deel van die noorde van Rusland.
items.blok: Die natuurlike plantegroei: naalde en keëls
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Larch' (deciduous conifer; 40.2% of Soviet forests in 1965); Springer chapter on larch forests (Forest Fund of Russia 1999): larch dominates about 263 million ha, 36.6% of Russia's forest area, mostly in Siberia and the Far East; Wikipedia 'Taiga': 'the Eastern Siberian taiga is a vast larch forest'. 'Een soort' means larch as a kind of tree (the genus), which also covers Canada's tamarack.

items.bewering: Die bome staan dikwels dig bymekaar. Die woudvloer is dikwels met mos, korsmos en lae struike bedek. Party naaldwoude is oop en lig met baie ruimte tussen die bome.
items.blok: Die natuurlike plantegroei: naalde en keëls
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Taiga': 'closed canopy forest, consisting of many closely-spaced trees and mossy groundcover' and 'the lichen woodland or sparse taiga, with trees that are farther-spaced and lichen groundcover'; lichens, mosses and shrubs on the forest floor.

items.bewering: Die wolf se pels word in die winter dik, en hy jag deur die koue.
items.blok: Die wildlewe kom die winter deur
items.bron: Northwest Trek Wildlife Park, 'Warm winter coats', and International Wolf Center (wolf.org) material: a dense underfur grows in autumn and thickens in winter; wolves travel and hunt all through winter. Wikipedia, 'Taiga': the timber wolf is a taiga predator.

items.bewering: Die swartbeer soek 'n hol en slaap deur 'n groot deel van die winter.
items.blok: Die wildlewe kom die winter deur
items.bron: US National Park Service, 'Black Bears' (nps.gov): in cold regions black bears hibernate for up to about seven months; BC government denning study: dens in or under trees and logs; Ontario Bruce Peninsula study: dens in rock crevices. 'Hol' covers all of these.

items.bewering: Baie voëls trek in die herfs weg en kom terug wanneer die lente kos bring.
items.blok: Die wildlewe kom die winter deur
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Taiga': many birds migrate there for the long summer days; of about 300 summer species 'only 30 stay for the winter'.

items.bewering: Hierdie streek is koud, terwyl die reënwoud en die warm woestyn warm is. Dit het 'n egte winter en 'n egte somer, waar die reënwoud se maande eenders lyk.
items.blok: Hoe hierdie streek van die ander twee verskil
items.bron: Royal Geographical Society world environments fact sheet (rainforest: monthly means about 26-28 °C, a yearly range of a few degrees); Britannica / Ohio University subarctic climate (largest seasonal range of any climate).

items.bewering: Oor enorme gebiede groei min soorte bome, maar in die reënwoud groei baie soorte saam.
items.blok: Hoe hierdie streek van die ander twee verskil
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Taiga': 'the taiga has low botanical diversity', with trees from 'four main genera'.

items.bewering: naaldwoud: 'n Woud waar die meeste bome naalde in plaas van breë blare het.
items.blok: naaldwoud
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Taiga' (coniferous forest made up mostly of pines, spruces, larches and firs). 'Die meeste' rightly allows for the birch, aspen and poplar that grow among them.

items.bewering: naaldboom: 'n Boom met smal naalde as blare, wat gewoonlik keëls dra.
items.blok: naaldboom
items.bron: Britannica Kids, 'Conifer' (cone-bearing trees, needle leaves); 'gewoonlik' rightly allows for conifers without woody cones, such as yew and juniper.

items.bewering: keël: Die deel met skubbe waarin die meeste naaldbome hulle saad dra.
items.blok: keël
items.bron: Britannica Kids, 'Conifer': 'woody cones with seeds attached to the scales'; Michigan State University botany pages: ovules borne on cone scales.

items.bewering: korsmos: 'n Swam en 'n klein lewende ding wat saamgroei. Die klein lewende ding maak kos uit sonlig.
items.blok: korsmos
items.bron: British Lichen Society, 'What is a Lichen?', and LiveScience, 'What Are Lichens?': a lichen is a partnership between a fungus and an alga and/or cyanobacterium (both microscopic), and that partner makes food by photosynthesis.

opsomming: All 27 claims check out against outside sources, including the seven superlatives and quantifiers and the needle comparison; nothing needs changing and nothing is open.
